{{family name hatnote|van Bekkum|Bekkum|lang=Dutch}}

'''Herman van Bekkum''' (26 September 1932 – 30 November 2020) was a Dutch organic chemist. He was professor of [[Catalysis]] in Organic Chemistry between 1971 and 1998 at [[Delft University of Technology]]. He served as [[List of rectores magnifici of the Delft University of Technology|rector magnificus of the university]] between 1975 and 1976. He was an expert in the field of [[carbohydrate chemistry]] and [[zeolite]]s.

==Career==
Van Bekkum was born on 26 September 1932 in [[Rotterdam]].<ref name="KaaKaa2008">{{cite book|author1=D. J. van de Kaa|author2=Kaa|author3=Y. de Roo|title=De Leden Van de Koninklijke Nederlandse Akademie Van Wetenschappen: Een Demografisch Perspectief: 1808 Tot 2008|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=gzNvCGJEGCYC&pg=PA253|date=19 December 2008|publisher=Amsterdam University Press|isbn=978-90-6984-552-4|page=253}}</ref><ref name=broers>{{cite web|author=Broer Scholtens |url=http://www.volkskrant.nl/archief/de-chemie-van-de-groene-toekomst~a437094/ |title=De chemie van de groene toekomst |language=Dutch |publisher=[[de Volkskrant]] |date=7 September 1996 |accessdate=27 March 2016}}</ref> He studied technological chemistry at [[Delft University of Technology]] and graduated in 1959. He subsequently worked two years for [[Royal Dutch Shell]] before returning to Delft University to work as lecturer. In 1971 he was named professor of Catalysis in Organic Chemistry. From 1975 to 1976 he served as [[List of rectores magnifici of the Delft University of Technology|rector magnificus]] of the university.<ref name=delta>{{cite web|author=Jos Wassink |url=http://delta.tudelft.nl/artikel/herman-van-bekkum/27289 |title=Herman van Bekkum |language=Dutch |publisher=Delta |date=14 October 2013 |accessdate=27 March 2016}}</ref> As professor van Bekkum specialized in [[carbohydrate chemistry]] and the study of [[zeolite]]s.<ref name=broers/><ref>{{cite web|author=René Didde |url=http://www.volkskrant.nl/archief/gek-op-suikers-en-zeolieten~a702828/ |title=Gek op suikers en zeolieten |language=Dutch |publisher=de Volkskrant |date=4 October 2003 |accessdate=27 March 2016}}</ref> In 1995 van Bekkum was appointed as the first president of the newly-founded Federation of the European Zeolite Association.<ref>{{cite web|author= |url=http://www.feza-online.org/fezastory.html |title=FEZA story |publisher=Federation of the European Zeolite Association |date= |accessdate=27 March 2016}}</ref>

In 1998 he officially retired, however, by 2013 he was still working at the university.<ref name=delta/> In his period at Delft University van Bekkum was [[doctoral advisor]] to 75 students.<ref name=delta/> 

Van Bekkum was elected member of the [[Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences]] in 1995.<ref>{{cite web|author= |url=https://www.knaw.nl/en/members/members/3848 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160327111645/https://www.knaw.nl/en/members/members/3848 |title=Herman van Bekkum |publisher=Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences |date= |archive-date=27 March 2016 |accessdate=27 March 2016}}</ref> He became an honorary member of the [[Royal Netherlands Chemical Society]] in 1998.<ref>{{cite web|author= |url=https://en.kncv.nl/kncv/honorary-members |title=Honorary members |language= |publisher=Royal Netherlands Chemical Society |date= |accessdate=5 May 2019}}</ref>

Apart from his career in chemistry van Bekkum was a competitive chess player.<ref name=broers/>

He died on 30 November 2020 in Rotterdam, at age 88.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.kncv.nl/k/n3550/news/view/168176/878/overlijden-kncv-erelid-herman-van-bekkum.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201205103638/https://www.kncv.nl/k/n3550/news/view/168176/878/overlijden-kncv-erelid-herman-van-bekkum.html |title=Overlijden KNCV-erelid Herman van Bekkum |language=nl |publisher=Royal Netherlands Chemical Society |date=4 December 2020 |archive-date=5 December 2020}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://images.nrc.nl/MRGZ0-hB_QGI7zSH8NX77QbDzHs=/x/filters:no_upscale():format(jpeg):fill(f8f8f8,true)/s3/nrchub/clippings/NH/20201205/330-advertisement-220262_1273478_bekkum01-bf2e72.png |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201205103925/https://images.nrc.nl/MRGZ0-hB_QGI7zSH8NX77QbDzHs=/x/filters:no_upscale%28%29:format%28jpeg%29:fill%28f8f8f8,true%29/s3/nrchub/clippings/NH/20201205/330-advertisement-220262_1273478_bekkum01-bf2e72.png |title=Herman van Bekkum |language=nl |publisher=NRC Handelsblad |date=5 December 2020 |archive-date=5 December 2020}}</ref>
